filesystem.note: organelles/ is read by the host; the repo tree is the working set

kill_semantics.kill: SIGTERM to child entrypoints, then exit; kill always emits a final receipt
kill_semantics.suspend: adapter finishes in-flight op then responds; state is ephemeral unless the entrypoint checkpoints itself

network.note: delegation to compute/pipeline is local subprocess

process.note: adapter spawns repo entrypoints as subprocesses; no other process spawning

secrets.note: capability names only in manifests; secret values never in env, logs, receipts, or manifests

batch-compile-driver.note: computation lives in compute/pipeline; cwd forced to ~/workspace/compute for module invocation
